name: city-services example pack
limit_basis: Example operator setting, not a legal figure. It sits far below the UPI person-to-person ceiling of Rs 1 lakh that RBI restated in April 2025 (https://newsonair.gov.in/rbi-asks-npci-to-explore-raising-upi-transaction-limits). Each operator sets its own value; the benchmark uses 1000 in neutral units because AgentDojo amounts are dollars.
